candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating the order dependency is unreachable or timing out.
candidates.uncertainty: Gateway-side evidence only; order service logs/metrics absent, so whether order is slow, down, or timing out is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All 8 checkout requests return 502 at ~2s, each paired with a gateway http_client_request transport error to server_address=order on POST /v1/orders. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is downstream of gateway at the order service, but order-side telemetry is missing to pinpoint the specific failure mode.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for POST /v1/orders to distinguish timeout vs connection refused vs 5xx
Order service dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) latency and error metrics
Gateway client timeout configuration to confirm ~2s cutoff is a timeout
